user_hypothesis_status: Confirmed as a conjecture, not an axiom; exact zero vacuum energy and supersymmetry are not required.

primary_sources.title: Stephen P. Martin, Two-loop effective potential for a general renormalizable theory and softly broken supersymmetry
primary_sources.use: Equations 4.3/4.13 independently check the 1/8 quartic combinatorial factor. Section 8.1 illustrates interaction-level cancellations. Its subtracted integrals do not replace the present finite proper-time integrals.

primary_sources.title: Guido Festuccia and Nathan Seiberg, Rigid Supersymmetric Theories in Curved Superspace
primary_sources.use: Section 2: curved-background preservation of rigid supersymmetry needs compatible background and auxiliary fields, not just free flat-space mass pairing.
